articles.title_en: Sources of Limited Consideration and Market Power in E-Commerce
articles.title_cn: 电子商务中有限考虑与市场势力的来源
articles.abstract_en: This article develops techniques for the empirical analysis of repeated sequential search over unordered alternatives using data on consumer search processes. I use these techniques to assess why consumers conduct little search in e-commerce and often pay significantly above the minimum available price for a product. Search costs could explain these facts, as could pre-search seller differentiation: Consumers with low search costs may not visit stores they dislike based on information known before search. I find that seller differentiation is primarily responsible for limited consideration and market power. (JEL D11, D21, D43, D83, L81)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了利用消费者搜索过程数据进行无序备选项重复顺序搜索实证分析的技术。我运用这些技术来评估为何消费者在电子商务中搜索甚少，且常常支付远高于产品最低可得价格的价格。搜索成本可以解释这些事实，搜索前的卖方差异化同样可以：搜索成本较低的消费者可能不会访问他们在搜索前基于已知信息而不喜欢的商店。我发现卖方差异化是导致有限考虑和市场势力的主要原因。(JEL D11, D21, D43, D83, L81)

articles.title_en: Backward Induction Reasoning beyond Backward Induction
articles.title_cn: 超越逆向归纳的逆向归纳推理
articles.abstract_en: Backward induction (BI) is only defined for perfect information games, but its logic is also invoked in many concepts for imperfect or incomplete information games. Yet, the meaning of BI reasoning is not clear in these settings, and we lack a way to capture the essence of BI without assuming equilibrium. We introduce backward rationalizability, a nonequilibrium solution concept for incomplete information games, which we argue distills the logic of BI reasoning. We show several of its properties and discuss a few applications, including a new version of Lipnowski and Sadler’s (2019) peer-confirming equilibrium. (JEL C72, C73, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 逆向归纳（BI）仅针对完全信息博弈定义，但其逻辑也被许多不完全或不完美信息博弈的概念所引用。然而，在这些设定中，BI推理的含义并不清晰，我们缺乏一种在不假设均衡的情况下捕捉BI本质的方法。我们引入了逆向可理性化，这是一个针对不完全信息博弈的非均衡解概念，我们认为它提炼了BI推理的逻辑。我们展示了其若干性质，并讨论了几个应用，包括Lipnowski和Sadler（2019）的同伴确认均衡的一个新版本。（JEL C72, C73, D83）

articles.title_en: Power, Property Rights, and the Dynamics of Local Wealth Appropriation
articles.title_cn: 权力、产权与地方财富侵占的动态
articles.abstract_en: We examine the dynamic connections between local wealth inequality and the local politics of property rights. A jurisdiction comprises a politically dominant in-group and a marginalized out-group. At each date, the jurisdiction exploits weaknesses in due process rights under the legal system to redistribute property claims away from the out-group and toward the in-group. It combines takings and zoning with the leveraging of public assets to deter legal challenges. This leverage varies over time and depends on status quo effects and asymmetries in legal treatment of assets. The results show how local politics and policies are linked to wealth disparities. (JEL D31, D72, H13, H77, K11, P14, R52)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了地方财富不平等与地方产权政治之间的动态联系。一个辖区由政治上占主导地位的内群体和被边缘化的外群体组成。在每个时期，辖区利用法律体系中正当程序权利的弱点，将财产权利从外群体重新分配向内群体。它结合征收和区划，并利用公共资产来阻止法律挑战。这种杠杆随时间变化，并取决于现状效应和资产法律待遇的不对称性。结果表明地方政治和政策如何与财富差距相关联。(JEL D31, D72, H13, H77, K11, P14, R52)

articles.abstract_en: Individuals often attach a special meaning to attaining a certain goal, and getting past a threshold marks the difference between success and failure. In this paper, we take a standard expected utility (EU) setting with an exogenous reference point that separates success from failure and define attitudes toward success and failure as features of preferences over lotteries. The distinctive feature of our definitions is that they concern a local reversal of the decision-maker’s risk attitude across the reference point. Our findings provide a unified view of several well-known models of reference-dependent preferences and suggest new forms of comparative statics exercises. (JEL D11, D44, D81, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 个体往往对达成某一特定目标赋予特殊意义，而跨越某一门槛则标志着成功与失败的差异。在本文中，我们采用一个带有外生参照点的标准期望效用（EU）框架，该参照点将成功与失败区分开来，并将对成功与失败的态度定义为对彩票偏好的特征。我们定义的特殊之处在于，它们涉及决策者风险态度在参照点处的局部逆转。我们的发现为几种著名的参照依赖偏好模型提供了统一的视角，并提出了比较静态分析的新形式。（JEL D11, D44, D81, D91）

articles.title_en: Behavioral Communities and the Atomic Structure of Networks
articles.title_cn: 行为社群与网络的原子结构
articles.abstract_en: When people coordinate their behaviors with their friends—e.g., choosing whether to adopt a new technology, protest against a government, attend university—divisions within a social network can lead to contrasting norms of behavior in different parts of the network. We define a society’s atoms to be groups of people who adopt the same behavior in every equilibrium. We show that the atoms are at least as coarse as blocks in stochastic block models, and that using knowledge of the atoms to seed the diffusion of a behavior significantly increases diffusion compared to seeding based on standard community detection algorithms. (JEL D85, D91, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 当人们与朋友协调行为时——例如，选择是否采用新技术、抗议政府、上大学——社交网络内的分裂可能导致网络不同部分出现对比鲜明的行为规范。我们将社会的原子定义为在每一个均衡中都采取相同行为的群体。我们证明，这些原子至少与随机块模型中的块一样粗糙，并且利用原子的知识来播种行为的传播，与基于标准社群检测算法的播种相比，显著增加了传播。(JEL D85, D91, Z13)

articles.abstract_en: This paper builds a theory of dynamic pricing for the sale of timed goods. The main friction is private and evolving valuation of the buyer prior to the date of consumption, which follows a Poisson process. A combination of membership fees and continuously increasing prices induces a threshold response from the buyer, endogenously segmenting the market along timing of purchase. This pricing mechanism achieves the deterministic global optimum. The tools developed here are shown to be useful in thinking about global incentives in dynamic mechanisms, and mapping dynamic pricing to the classic taxonomy of consumer-producer surplus and deadweight loss. (JEL D21, D82, D86)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个关于限时商品销售动态定价的理论。主要摩擦在于买方在消费日期之前私人且不断变化的估值，该估值遵循泊松过程。会员费与持续上涨的价格相结合，诱导买方产生阈值反应，从而在购买时机上内生地细分市场。这种定价机制实现了确定性的全局最优。本文开发的工具被证明在思考动态机制中的全局激励以及将动态定价映射到经典的消费者-生产者剩余和死重损失分类方面是有用的。（JEL D21, D82, D86）

articles.title_en: Cardinality and Utilitarianism through Social Interactions
articles.title_cn: 基数性与功利主义：基于社会互动的视角
articles.abstract_en: We provide axioms that relate the preferences of each group in a society to the preferences of the subgroups contained in them. These axioms yield cardinal utility indices for each individual and a representation of group preferences as the group-dependent weighted sum of the utility indices of the members of that group. We show that these weights are group independent whenever one additional axiom and a mild linear independence assumption are satisfied. (JEL D11, D71, D81, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一些公理，将社会中每个群体的偏好与其所包含的子群体的偏好联系起来。这些公理为每个个体产生基数效用指数，并将群体偏好表示为该群体成员效用指数的群体依赖加权和。我们证明，当满足一个额外的公理和一个温和的线性无关假设时，这些权重是群体独立的。（JEL D11, D71, D81, D83）

articles.abstract_en: We study limited strategic leadership. A collection of subsets covering the leader’s action space determines her commitment opportunities. We characterize the outcomes resulting from all possible commitment structures of this kind. If the commitment structure is an interval partition, then the leader’s payoff is bounded by her Stackelberg and Cournot payoffs. Under general commitment structures, the leader may obtain a payoff that is less than her lowest Cournot payoff. We apply our results to a textbook duopoly model and characterize the commitment structures leading to consumer- and producer-optimal outcomes. (JEL C72, D43)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究有限战略领导力。覆盖领导者行动空间的一组子集决定了她的承诺机会。我们刻画了所有此类承诺结构可能产生的结果。如果承诺结构是区间划分，则领导者的收益受其斯塔克尔伯格和古诺收益的约束。在一般承诺结构下，领导者可能获得低于其最低古诺收益的收益。我们将结果应用于教科书式双寡头模型，并刻画了导致消费者和生产者最优结果的承诺结构。（JEL C72, D43）

articles.abstract_en: We generalize the captive-and-shopper model of sales to allow asymmetries in production costs and captive audiences, in oligopoly. Bothkinds of asymmetry determine the firms that compete (via randomized sales) to serve the price-comparing shoppers, while other firms exploit their captive audiences. In contrast to a model with symmetric costs (but asymmetric captive audiences), there are natural situations in which more than two firms use sales by engaging in pairwisebattles across distinct price intervals. We also study the choice of production technologies via innovation and extensions to consider costly acquisitions of captives and shoppers, and captives’ choice of captor. (JEL D11, D21, D43, L14, O31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们推广了销售中的俘虏与购物者模型，以允许寡头垄断中生产成本和俘虏受众的不对称性。两种不对称性决定了哪些企业通过随机销售竞争以服务比较价格的购物者，而其他企业则利用其俘虏受众。与成本对称（但俘虏受众不对称）的模型相比，存在自然情形，其中超过两家企业通过在不同价格区间进行成对竞争来使用销售策略。我们还研究了通过创新选择生产技术，并扩展至考虑获取俘虏和购物者的成本，以及俘虏对俘获者的选择。(JEL D11, D21, D43, L14, O31)

articles.abstract_en: I study a simple equity-efficiency problem: A designer allocates a fixed amount of money to a population of agents differing in privately observed marginal values for money. She can only screen by imposing an “ordeal”—that is, by allocating more money to agents who engage in a socially wasteful activity (such as queuing or filling out forms). Giving a lumpsum transfer is outperformed by an ordeal mechanism when agents with the lowest money-denominated cost of engaging in the wasteful activity have an expected value for money that exceeds the average value by more than a factor of two. (JEL D63, D82, H23, I38)
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究一个简单的公平-效率问题：设计者将固定金额的资金分配给一群代理人，这些代理人对资金的私人观察边际价值各不相同。她只能通过施加“磨难”——即，将更多资金分配给从事社会浪费活动（如排队或填写表格）的代理人——来进行筛选。当从事浪费活动的最低货币成本代理人对资金的预期价值超过平均水平两倍以上时，磨难机制优于一次性转移支付。（JEL D63, D82, H23, I38）
